name: IoT weather station
description: I designed and developed a complete weather monitoring system using an ESP32 and three environmental sensors to measure air quality, temperature, humidity, and atmospheric pressure. The collected data is structured in JSON format and sent through a custom API to Azure Event Hubs before being stored in a MySQL database managed with phpMyAdmin. I also created a React dashboard that periodically updates to visualize real-time readings and historical trends, along with a Swift-based iOS application that provides access to the same information from mobile devices.

name: Platform with Unity and AWS
description: Developed and launched a comprehensive educational platform that embeds a Unity-based mental math game, built with C#, into an interactive web environment. Designed the backend architecture using AWS Lambda, Amazon RDS, and S3, supporting user management, streamlined actions, usage analytics, website hosting, and seamless integration of the foundation’s game.
